stdout:
usage: fleet-switchboard orders add [-h] --charter CHARTER [--by BY]
                                    [--from SENDER]
                                    text

positional arguments:
  text               The order, in the owner's words (1 to 300 characters, one
                     line)

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --charter CHARTER  The charter issue: N (in your own repo) or owner/repo#N
  --by BY            Who ordered it (default: the operating-system user)
  --from SENDER      Lab only: the caller's fleet name
